verdict: Lead volume dipped with budget; your cost per lead improved meaningfully.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 121 leads at an average cost of $11.57 per lead across Meta. This past week, daily spend dropped to roughly $28 per day compared to about $64 the week prior, and lead volume followed — down 37% week-over-week. Importantly, the ads themselves did not underperform: cost per lead actually improved 25% in that same stretch, meaning the budget that did run converted more efficiently. Two tracking items — phone-call attribution and CRM contact sync — are being resolved so that the full picture of leads and appointments is visible by month end. Once those are in place, the August scoreboard will be reliable ahead of the renewal decision on August 31.
